summary: Tested the P0 admin 'Message Customer' guard + the two new detail modals (Orders detail, Approvals applicant detail). All 7 backend guard tests pass (placeholder-email rejection, empty subject/body, non-admin 403, unknown user 404, unauth 401, is_real_email unit). All three UI dialogs render and expose the required data-testids. The 'No valid email' badge logic is correct (confirmed rendering inside the Approvals applicant detail dialog for a driver with no email), but the badge could not be observed directly in the Users tab because the seeded placeholder user is past the page-1 window (see backend_issues.minor).

minor.issue: `q` (search) query param is accepted but IGNORED — the response is identical with or without `q=id_start`. The Users-tab search box therefore does server-side filtering only on the already-paginated slice (client-side filter). This makes it impossible to discover users beyond the first ~200 rows. Recommend adding {$regex: q, $options: 'i'} filter on email/name in the admin/users endpoint.

Hard cap appears to be ~200 users returned even when `limit=2000` is sent (collection has more docs). The seeded placeholder user `id_start_demo_qa@gmail.com` is therefore not surfaced by the listing without proper search/pagination. Test fixture still works (backend test reached it through unbounded iteration in tests).
Returns 500 on /admin page load (Axios error visible in console). Pre-existing per iteration_22 report; surfacing again as it impacts the Approvals tab data.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py message_user endpoint correctly chains is_real_email() guard BOTH at the request layer (line 1397) AND inside graph_mail.send_mail() (line 212) — defense in depth, good.

graph_mail.is_real_email() prefix list (`id_start_`, `id_noapp_`, `id_session_`, `id_kyc_`, `sched_test_`, `resto_test_`, `driver_test_`, `qa_test_`) plus placeholder domains (test.com / example.* / test.test) is a sane allow-by-default policy.
AdminPanel.js is still ~1380 lines; the new dialogs increased the size. Consider splitting Users / Orders / Approvals into separate tab components.

isPlaceholderEmail() helper duplicates the backend's _PLACEHOLDER_LOCAL_PREFIXES / domains list — should be kept in sync. Suggest exposing the check via a backend endpoint (e.g. include a derived `email_is_real: false` flag per user in /api/admin/users) so the FE never has to duplicate the rule.

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug RCA confirmed: Admin->Users 'Message Customer' was emailing placeholder addresses left by QA seeds (id_start_*, sched_test_*, etc.) because there was no recipient validation before posting to Microsoft Graph sendMail. Mitigation now in place: (1) graph_mail.is_real_email() rejects placeholder-prefix locals AND placeholder domains AND syntactic non-emails; (2) graph_mail.send_mail() raises InvalidRecipientEmail when called with a placeholder; (3) POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/message pre-checks the recipient and returns HTTP 400 with a human-readable message; (4) AdminPanel.js renders the 'No valid email' badge and disables the message button when isPlaceholderEmail(email) is true. The only remaining gap is the admin-users LIST endpoint search (q param) which prevents admins from finding the offending users — see action_items.
